title: Protocol
description: A protocol of cited steps (Spec 1 Contracts table).

schema_version.description: Contract version. Spec 1: include a schema_version field.

status.description: Spec 1 (add-only): 'draft' or 'approved'. Only approved steps are rendered; the linter and the engine enforce it.

drafted_by.description: Spec 1 (add-only): the tool and model that drafted the step text, when AI drafted it.

approved_by.description: Spec 1 (add-only): the team member who approved the step; must be on content/approvers.json. Never an AI.

approved_hash.description: Spec 1 (add-only): sha256 of the step's text, source, equipment and rescuers at approval. Any later edit makes it stale, so the step is back to draft.

condition_ids.description: Spec 1 (add-only): condition records this protocol serves (content/conditions/<id>.json).
